🧠 Ek chhota sa interview question

Q. Git aur Version Control me difference kya hai?

Answer:

  • Version Control ek concept/system hai jo file history manage karta hai.

  • Git us concept ka software implementation hai.

  • Car = Implementation

Waise hi:

  • Version Control = Concept

  • Git = Software
